attack_surface.new_agent_context_ingress: The `narrowed` message an MCP tool returns: fixed platform text chosen by a code that must match ^[a-z_]{1,64}$. No third-party text.

findings.title: The narrowed-read code varied with the turn id a caller sent
findings.description: A first version said `turn_person` for any share-tier execution id of the agent, running or not, and `running_turn` for an unknown id, so the response header told a caller holding the agent's key whether an id it chose was a share turn of that agent.
findings.exploit_scenario: A turn sends X-Trinity-Execution-Id with candidate ids on any narrowed read and compares the header value across answers.
findings.impact: Existence and tier of an execution id on the key's own agent. Not new in practice: the turn-tier read already answers this to the same key.
findings.recommendation: Say `turn_person` only of a share turn that is itself RUNNING; any other id reads `running_turn` while a share turn runs and `unverified` otherwise.

findings.title: A value a handler set for the marker header reached the client when no code was noted
findings.description: The middleware removed a pre-existing X-Trinity-Read-Narrowed only when it had a code of its own to send.
findings.exploit_scenario: A route that forwards an upstream response's headers would pass an upstream-chosen marker to an MCP tool, which shows it to an agent. No such route exists today.
findings.impact: A forged 'narrowed' note in a tool answer. Not reachable today.
findings.recommendation: Strip the header on every response start, then append when a code was noted.

findings.title: The new `self` census rule accepted assert_own_agent alone
findings.description: `assert_own_agent` holds an agent's key to its own agent and is a no-op for a person, so a route gated by it alone is open to any signed-in person, yet it would have passed as `self`, a tier the runtime fence leaves open in a restricted turn.
findings.exploit_scenario: A future route declared `self` with only assert_own_agent passes CI and is callable by any signed-in person for any agent name.
findings.impact: A guard that would bless a mis-gated route. No live row is affected.
findings.recommendation: Count assert_own_agent as a self gate only beside an access check; the self-only helpers stand alone.
